title: Aina Opens Pre-Orders for AI Control Ring With Integrated Screen
summary:
The startup has developed a new piece of wearable hardware designed to let users interact with artificial intelligence without needing to unlock a smartphone. Aina's new ring includes a built-in display, microphone, and joystick, allowing users to voice-command their digital agents, record notes, and manage smart home devices or Apple TV. The hardware provides proactive suggestions, or "cues," that appear on the screen based on a user's routine, such as a prompt to join a meeting, which can be accepted or dismissed with a thumb flick.

Aina has raised $5.5M to build the interface, which aims to reduce the friction of managing AI assistants by providing a dedicated physical control point for approvals and tasks. The company has now opened pre-orders for the device.

selectedTweets.text:
What if your devices, apps and agents knew what you wanted?

You finish breakfast, and your Uber is booked.
Running late, your agent sends a “Running late” text.
You reach home, and your lights turn on.

AI is proactive now. But it still needs your yes. It waits, for you to unlock your phone, open an app and tap approve. Every time, hundreds of times a day.

AI needs its own interface.

Aina is a ring with a screen that predicts and shows you the three things you’ll need next. One flick of your thumb, and it’s done. For everything.

✦ Cues: proactive suggestions, ready before you need them
✦ Voice: talk to your agents, take notes, dictate
✦ Remote: control your music, Mac and TV
✦ Calls: right from your hand

Pre-orders open now
